x: Malcolm Robinson, our only entrant, found himself up against opponents such as Earl, Linford, Chapman and Ellis, but with his usual show of determination and ever-improving ability he secured a point with a time of 4m.2·4s., another best performance.

…, Charlie must have felt a little overwhelmed by the company in his coach - Hyman, Peter Cl[illegible]rk, Brian Fernee, Chapman, Roath, Perkins, Mike Barratt, George Brown, Maynard, Palmer and Sando just to mention a few are not designed to rouse one's confidence.…
Ron Shipley, after a bad spell at half way recovered well and only just failed to catch Chapman and Lewis of Woodford, who were 4th and 5th.

These two battled throughout and soon disposed of Walton, Blackheath and Highgate but Ealing represented by Blagrove, Brighton with Briault, and Woodford with Chapman were making faster progress from behind and eventually passed our runner.
Cliff Roffey ran a well judged stage in this his last race in England. He soon passed Ipswich, although Woodford (Chapman 15.05) had moved further away and Denis O'Gorman with 15.02 had taken St.
